name: MLAE (Linear, Suzuki et al. 2020)
description: Linearly Incremental Sequence (LIS) Grover depth schedule n_k = k (k = 0, 1, ..., M) with uniform shots per rung and exact global maximum-likelihood estimation (Suzuki et al. 2020, Quantum Inf. Process. 19, 75), achieving O(Q^{-3/4}) error scaling.
